summary: Backend upload fix verified on production https://cinemaries.fr. All 5 requested test scenarios (A/B/C/D/E) PASS. Nginx alias mismatch is resolved by symlink /var/www/cinemaries/backend/uploads -> /srv/cinemaries/uploads. Fresh uploads via POST /api/admin/upload land in the correct directory and are immediately servable via /api/uploads/{name}.

minor.issue: Response 'url' is relative (starts with /api/uploads/...) because APP_PUBLIC_URL env var is empty on prod. Not blocking (frontend already handles this) but inconsistent with intent of code line 3812 which prefixes with APP_PUBLIC_URL. Consider setting APP_PUBLIC_URL=https://cinemaries.fr in backend env.

Files freshly uploaded by the FastAPI service are owned by root:root (not www-data:www-data). Perms 644 keep them readable by Nginx so it works, but service should ideally run as www-data or files be chown'd on write for consistency.

action_items: Optional: set APP_PUBLIC_URL=https://cinemaries.fr in backend .env so /api/admin/upload returns absolute URLs (consistent with hosting_upload endpoints).
Optional: run the FastAPI service as www-data (or chown newly written files) so uploads have consistent ownership with pre-existing files.
critical_code_review_comments: UPLOAD_DIR = ROOT_DIR / 'uploads' (server.py:59) is fragile — relies on external symlink to align with Nginx alias. Consider reading it from env (e.g. UPLOAD_DIR env var) with a documented default matching Nginx config, to prevent regression if the symlink is ever removed.
seed_data_creation: Uploaded two tiny 1x1 JPEGs (350 bytes each) via /api/admin/upload during Test B. Both were cleaned up from /srv/cinemaries/uploads/ via SSH after verification. DB rows in db.uploads were NOT deleted (no delete endpoint used) — 2 small entries remain.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Test file /app/backend/tests/test_uploads_prod.py hits production directly (https://cinemaries.fr). It logs in as contact@cinemaries.fr, uploads a tiny JPEG, and verifies immediate GET on returned URL. Two DB rows in uploads collection (350-byte test JPEGs) may remain after runs — non-blocking.
rca_of_issue: Original bug: UPLOAD_DIR = ROOT_DIR / 'uploads' resolved to /var/www/cinemaries/backend/uploads/ while Nginx serves /api/uploads/* from an alias to /srv/cinemaries/uploads/. Files landed in the former, Nginx searched the latter -> 404. Fix (server-side, no code): rsync'd existing files to /srv/cinemaries/uploads/, replaced /var/www/cinemaries/backend/uploads with a symlink -> /srv/cinemaries/uploads, chown www-data:www-data, chmod 755, restarted cinemaries-backend. Verified: symlink present, fresh POST /api/admin/upload writes to /srv/cinemaries/uploads and GET on returned URL returns 200 with correct Content-Type and exact size.
